newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures continue to weaken on Atlanta Fed.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures continue to weaken on Atlanta Fed.

text.p: May 13 - U.S. debt futures continued to weaken on the Atlanta Fed numbers. Atlanta Fed business activity index rose to 22.1 in April vs revised 8.6 in March. June T-bonds fell to 109-30/32, below the 200-day moving average of 110-03/32. Further support is at 109-16/32, last Friday's low. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
